secondary: other: bowl rotated onto its side in the rim pinch grasp during the carry (tilt > 45 deg from 1096)
what_happened: Layout 10 (French-door fridge Refrigerator066, glass shelves), deep brown wooden bowl_8, cucumber, drumstick 013. Stage 0: cucumber grasped 82 and dropped into the bowl at 145 (stage 0 from 146). Stage 1: drumstick grasped 306, carried over the bowl by ~410 and then held just above the bowl rim, slowly lowering, until 633 (~220 steps; wrist view almost unchanged 450-620); stage 1 at 634 (488 steps after stage 0, median 216). Stage 2: 680-900 the gripper fumbled at the rim, re-grasping the drumstick end that stuck out over the rim (drumstick holds 687-820, 901-928) and tipping the bowl; at 902-936 it closed on the bowl rim together with the drumstick and lifted it (0.445 m). The base drove to the fridge 960-1150. The bowl rotated in the pinch grasp and was carried on its side, opening toward the robot (tipped_over 1096-1210). At 1180-1260 the arm held the tilted bowl high, against the front edge of an upper glass shelf (ice-tray distractor on it), not on the shelf. The gripper opened 1192-1248 (0.022 -> 0.072) and then closed fully (0.005 at 1264): the bowl slid off the shelf edge and fell ~1.26 m to the floor at ~1268-1276, landing upside down with the drumstick under it and the cucumber beside it. The arm stayed in the fridge for the remaining 430 steps without trying to pick anything up.
causal_chain: rim pinch grasp (with the drumstick in the fingers) let the bowl rotate onto its side during the carry (1096) -> at the fridge the tilted bowl was pressed against the front edge of a high shelf instead of set onto it (1180-1260) -> gripper opened at ~1192-1248 with the bowl not supported -> bowl fell off the shelf edge to the floor (1268) -> cucumber out, bowl upside down on the floor; stage 2 impossible
self_recovery: Before the carry, it re-grasped the drumstick end sticking over the rim twice (687-820, 901-928) and kept it in the bowl. At the fridge, after the bowl fell, nothing.
official_criterion_notes: Stage 0 stays 'complete' until ~1632 although the bowl is upside down on the floor: check_obj_in_receptacle only needs contact plus xy distance, so the drumstick lying under the inverted bowl counts as 'in the bowl'. Hold 3 height_drop_after_release 1.263 m confirms the fall to the floor.

packet_facts: gripper width 0.022 to 1184, opens to 0.072 at 1248, 0.005 at 1264

uncertain_about: Whether the opening at 1192-1248 was a deliberate release or a grasp loss against the shelf edge; either way the bowl was not on the shelf when the fingers opened.
